svg.title: Counting the cat sat on the mat, the act with the first table: each word's bytes summed pick its bucket, and only that bucket's list is walked
svg.text: printf 'the cat sat on the mat, the act\n' | DS_STATS=1 bin/freq
its list, newest first: each entry's index, then its key
5 of the 1024 buckets are used; the others hold -1, an empty list

g.title: "the" sums to 321, bucket 321, which is empty: "the" is new and goes in as entry 0.
"cat" sums to 312, bucket 312, which is empty: "cat" is new and goes in as entry 1.
"sat" sums to 328, bucket 328, which is empty: "sat" is new and goes in as entry 2.
"on" sums to 221, bucket 221, which is empty: "on" is new and goes in as entry 3.
"the" sums to 321, bucket 321: its list is walked and "the" is found after 1 probe. Its count goes up; the table is not changed.
"mat" sums to 322, bucket 322, which is empty: "mat" is new and goes in as entry 4.
"the" sums to 321, bucket 321: its list is walked and "the" is found after 1 probe. Its count goes up; the table is not changed.
"act" sums to 312, the same as "cat": bucket 312. "cat" has the same hash but other bytes, so "act" is not there, and goes in at the head of the list.
